name: gamenet_host_update_session_desc_status_fields
description: GameNet::HostUpdateSessionDescStatusFields is a host-only wrapper that updates DirectPlay session descriptor custom status fields through zNetwork.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional and uses a fake DirectPlay provider.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x434550 validates the host gate, extraction of current session status fields, overwrite of event/status/value/aux fields, and commit through zNetwork::ApplyStatusFieldsToSessionDesc.
The native GameNet smoke verifies non-host no-op, host status-field update, preserved session metadata, and provider failure return.
